'''Yaled IV''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]. It was home to a [[Unidentified Yaled IV cyborgs|group]] of [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]] who worshiped the [[Battle droid/Legends|war robot]] deity [[ZIMM]].
